description.zh:
触发告警的阈值。

- 当**Type**取值为**delay**时，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。

- 当**Type**取值为**full_timeout**时，单位为小时且需为整数。

> 当**Type**取值为**delay**或**full_timeout**且**State**取值为**Y**时，本参数必须传入。
description.en:
The threshold for triggering an alert.

- If **Type** is set to **delay**, the unit is seconds and the value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. A value of 10 or greater is recommended to avoid alert fluctuations caused by network issues or database loads.

- If **Type** is set to **full_timeout**, the unit is hours and the value must be an integer.

> This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **delay** or **full_timeout** and **State** is set to **Y**.

description.zh: 迁移、同步或订阅任务ID，可通过调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)获取。
description.en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to obtain the task ID.

description.zh:
增量校验任务的统计周期，单位为分钟。

> 当前支持取值为1分钟、5分钟、10分钟和30分钟。
description.en:
The statistical period of the incremental verification task. Unit: minutes.

> Valid values: 1, 5, 10, and 30.

description.zh:
告警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
>-  本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持中国内地手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
- 国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持[通过云监控平台为DTS任务设置报警规则](~~175876~~)。
description.en:
The mobile phone numbers of alert contacts, separated by commas (,).
>-  This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and only for the Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers. A maximum of 10 mobile phone numbers can be specified.
- The international site does not support SMS-based alerting. You can only [set alert rules for DTS tasks through the CloudMonitor monitoring platform](~~175876~~).

description.zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
是否启用告警规则，取值：

- **Y**：启用。
- **N**：不启用。

默认值：**Y**
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. Valid values:

- **Y**: Enable the alert rule.
- **N**: Disable the alert rule.

Default value: **Y**.

description.zh: 增量校验任务的周期数。
description.en: The number of statistical periods for the incremental verification task.

description.zh:
监控项的类型，取值：
- **delay**：**延迟**监控项。
- **error**：**迁移状态**监控项。
- **full_timeout**：**全量运行耗时**监控项。

默认值：**error**；需手动填入。
description.en:
The type of the alert metric. Valid values:
- **delay**: the **Latency** metric.
- **error**: the **Migration Status** metric.
- **full_timeout**: the **Full Migration Duration** metric.

Default value: **error**. This parameter must be manually specified.

title.zh: 创建或修改任务告警规则
title.en: Create or modify a task alert rule

descriptions.zh:
DTS目前支持的监控项为**延迟**、**迁移状态**和**全量运行耗时**：

- **延迟**：监控增量数据迁移延迟信息，当迁移延迟、同步延迟或订阅延迟的时间超过设定值时（单位为秒），触发告警规则。
- **迁移状态**：监控任务的状态，当任务的状态为**异常**或**恢复**时，触发告警规则。
- **全量运行耗时**：全量运行的耗时，超过设定值时（单位为小时），触发告警规则。
descriptions.en:
DTS currently supports the following alert metrics: **Latency**, **Migration Status**, and **Full Migration Duration**:

- **Latency**: Monitors incremental data migration latency. An alert is triggered when the migration latency, synchronization latency, or change tracking latency exceeds the specified threshold (in seconds).
- **Migration Status**: Monitors the task status. An alert is triggered when the task status is **Error** or **Recovered**.
- **Full Migration Duration**: Monitors the duration of full data migration. An alert is triggered when the duration exceeds the specified threshold (in hours).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts create-job-monitor-rule --dts-job-id i03e3zty16i0000 --type delay --state Y --phone 13612340000,13712340000 --delay-rule-time 11 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 5 --times 2 --notice-value 2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
